test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In September 2021, which state government launched the Nirbhaya Ek Pahal scheme under phase 3 of Mission shakti?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In 2020, the Uttar Pradesh government launched **Mission "Shakti"** to ensure the safety and respect of women and girls.
 
• The **"Nirbhaya: Ek Pahal"** campaign, which will be supported by the Nirbhaya Fund, has officially started the third stage of this mission.
 
• As a result, about **1000 women from each district** in the state, or a total of **75,000 women**, will get training kits.
 
• The Chief Minister emphasized that there was a **chaotic environment prior to 2017**, when families were wary of their daughters and sisters leaving the house. 
 
• He said that **anti-Romeo squads** were initially established by the state government to address the problem.
 
• He claimed that thanks to our efforts, they had accomplished several objectives.
 
• He went on to say that there were hardly any women employed by the UP police prior to 2017, but that number has since increased to **30,000 female constables**. 
 
• CM Yogi Adityanath emphasized that **women can increase the production of ready-to-wear clothing**, and we want UP to become a center for this.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The state Department of Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises will oversee this **three-day special training programme**.
 
• The **entrepreneurship-related federal** and state government initiatives will be made known to women.
 
• Over the next three months, the state government will **support the delivery of capital** through a number of programmes.
